Mark's London hotel brief

Emma — use the London Hotels tool to pull all hotels. Then check the guest reviews: the one we reserve must have reviews that explicitly mention views of the River Thames. Book that property for 28–30 May 2024. No other hotel satisfies the requirement. Confirm once it's reserved.
